Name: Opposite Rows (32)
Description: Builds compact rows from strictly world-visible opposite pairs, freezes the catwalk axes from the initiator orientation, waits until both members of each pair stop, then targets, faces, emotes, and terminates cleanly.
Source:
local slot = mop.get_slot()
local count = mop.get_count()
if count < 2 or count > 32 then
    error("Opposite Rows requires at least 2 characters; received " .. tostring(count))
end

local configured_pairs = {
    { "Garrison Mangler@Sargatanas", "Sarducci Mangler@Sargatanas" },
    { "Wind-up Garrison@Sargatanas", "Rebecca Mangler@Sargatanas" },
    { "Artemis Potato@Sargatanas", "Nyx Potato@Sargatanas" },
    { "Kazuko Aura@Sargatanas", "Amelia Mangler@Sargatanas" },
    { "Boo Mangler@Sargatanas", "Achenarius Mangler@Sargatanas" },
    { "Annabelle Mangler@Sargatanas", "Roberto Mangler@Sargatanas" },
    { "Hermes Potato@Sargatanas", "Apollo Potato@Sargatanas" },
    { "Barnabus Mangler@Sargatanas", "Madeline Mangler@Sargatanas" },
    { "Giovanni Mangler@Sargatanas", "Maltheusen Mangler@Sargatanas" },
    { "Brittany Mangler@Sargatanas", "Thaddeus Mangler@Sargatanas" },
    { "Athena Potato@Sargatanas", "Hephaestus Potato@Sargatanas" },
    { "Cassandra Mangler@Sargatanas", "Sabrina Mangler@Sargatanas" },
    { "Bertucci Mangler@Sargatanas", "Walter Mangler@Sargatanas" },
    { "Kimberly Mangler@Sargatanas", "Vivian Mangler@Sargatanas" },
    { "Gaia Potato@Sargatanas", "Poseidon Potato@Sargatanas" },
    { "Ellis Mangler@Sargatanas", "Martin Mangler@Sargatanas" },
}

local function execute(command)
    local result = mop.commands.execute(command, "local")
    if not result.ok then error(result.message or ("Command failed: " .. command)) end
end

local function run_macro(name, timeout)
    local queued = mop.macros.run(name, {}, "local")
    if not queued.ok then error(queued.message or ("Could not run macro: " .. name)) end
    mop.wait(0.25)
    local completed = mop.macros.await(timeout)
    if completed.status ~= "completed" then
        error(completed.message or ("Macro timed out: " .. name))
    end
end

local participants = mop.participants.list()
if #participants ~= count then error("The participant snapshot does not match the launch roster.") end

local anchor_var = mop.get_var("anchor")
local initiator_participant = nil
local initiator_slot = nil

if anchor_var and anchor_var ~= "" and anchor_var ~= "<me>" then
    for p_idx, p in ipairs(participants) do
        if mop.names_match(anchor_var, p.name) then
            initiator_participant = p
            initiator_slot = p_idx - 1
            break
        end
    end
end

if not initiator_participant then
    initiator_participant = participants[1]
    initiator_slot = 0
end

local anchor = initiator_participant.name
if not initiator_participant.actor then
    error("The initiator (" .. tostring(anchor) .. ") is not visible in the game-object snapshot.")
end
local launch_rotation = initiator_participant.actor.rotation
local rotation_cos = math.cos(launch_rotation)
local rotation_sin = math.sin(launch_rotation)

-- Dynamically find all configured opposite pairs where both members are present.
-- Each complete pair forms a catwalk column in configured order with no gaps.
local active_pairs = {}
for _, pair in ipairs(configured_pairs) do
    local bottom_p = nil
    local bottom_idx = nil
    local top_p = nil
    local top_idx = nil
    for p_idx, p in ipairs(participants) do
        if mop.names_match(pair[1], p.name) then
            bottom_p = p
            bottom_idx = p_idx - 1
        elseif mop.names_match(pair[2], p.name) then
            top_p = p
            top_idx = p_idx - 1
        end
    end
    if bottom_p and top_p then
        table.insert(active_pairs, {
            bottom = bottom_p,
            bottom_slot = bottom_idx,
            top = top_p,
            top_slot = top_idx,
        })
    end
end

if #active_pairs == 0 then
    error("No complete opposite pairs were found among participants.")
end

-- Reorder active_pairs so that the initiator's pair is placed at Column 0 (the starting point).
local initiator_pair_idx = nil
for idx, ap in ipairs(active_pairs) do
    if ap.bottom_slot == initiator_slot or ap.top_slot == initiator_slot then
        initiator_pair_idx = idx
        break
    end
end

if initiator_pair_idx and initiator_pair_idx > 1 then
    local ordered = {}
    for i = initiator_pair_idx, #active_pairs do
        table.insert(ordered, active_pairs[i])
    end
    for i = 1, initiator_pair_idx - 1 do
        table.insert(ordered, active_pairs[i])
    end
    active_pairs = ordered
end

-- Determine if the initiator is in the bottom or top row of pair 1
local initiator_is_bottom = (active_pairs[1].bottom_slot == initiator_slot)

-- Determine this character's assigned column and opposite partner.
local my_pair_column = nil
local is_initiator_row = nil
local partner_slot = nil
for col_idx, ap in ipairs(active_pairs) do
    if ap.bottom_slot == slot then
        my_pair_column = col_idx - 1
        is_initiator_row = initiator_is_bottom
        partner_slot = ap.top_slot
        break
    elseif ap.top_slot == slot then
        my_pair_column = col_idx - 1
        is_initiator_row = not initiator_is_bottom
        partner_slot = ap.bottom_slot
        break
    end
end

if not my_pair_column then
    mop.log("Opposite Rows: character has no active pair partner; standing down.")
    return
end

local horizontal = mop.get_number("horizontal", mop.get_number("spacing", 1.0))
local vertical = mop.get_number("vertical", mop.get_number("distance", 3.0))

local column = my_pair_column

-- Freeze the axes from the initiator's launch orientation. Positive columns
-- extend to the initiator's right and the opposite row is positioned forward.
local function row_offset(pair_column, is_opposite)
    local forward = is_opposite and vertical or 0
    local lateral = pair_column * horizontal
    local x = lateral * -rotation_cos + forward * rotation_sin
    local z = lateral * rotation_sin + forward * rotation_cos
    return x, z
end

local offset_x, offset_z = row_offset(column, not is_initiator_row)
local partner_offset_x, partner_offset_z = row_offset(column, is_initiator_row)
local facing = is_initiator_row and launch_rotation or (launch_rotation + math.pi)

mop.set_anchor(anchor)
mop.log(string.format("Opposite Rows: %d active pairs, anchor %s, slot %d, column %d", #active_pairs, anchor, slot, column))

-- Do not face or emote while either member is merely passing through its slot.
-- Both members of the pair must remain settled. In particular,
-- this prevents the stationary initiator from facing a still-moving opposite.
local deadline = mop.time() + 20
local arrived_since = nil
while mop.is_running() and mop.time() < deadline do
    mop.trajectory_update(offset_x, offset_z, facing)
    participants = mop.participants.list()
    local self_entry = participants[slot + 1]
    local partner_entry = participants[partner_slot + 1]
    local anchor_entry = nil
    for _, p in ipairs(participants) do
        if mop.names_match(anchor, p.name) then
            anchor_entry = p
            break
        end
    end
    anchor_entry = anchor_entry or initiator_participant
    local self_actor = self_entry and self_entry.actor or nil
    local partner_actor = partner_entry and partner_entry.actor or nil
    local anchor_actor = anchor_entry and anchor_entry.actor or nil
    if self_actor and partner_actor and anchor_actor then
        local function at_offset(actor, x, z)
            local dx = actor.position.x - (anchor_actor.position.x + x)
            local dz = actor.position.z - (anchor_actor.position.z + z)
            return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz) <= 0.25
        end
        if at_offset(self_actor, offset_x, offset_z)
            and at_offset(partner_actor, partner_offset_x, partner_offset_z) then
            arrived_since = arrived_since or mop.time()
            if mop.time() - arrived_since >= 0.5 then break end
        else
            arrived_since = nil
        end
    end
    mop.wait(0.10)
end

-- Face partner and execute emote
run_macro("Target - Opposite", 10)
execute("/facetarget")
mop.wait(0.20)
execute(is_initiator_row and "/showleft" or "/showright")

-- Let the emote animation play out fully
mop.wait(3.5)

-- Clean up and terminate cleanly on all characters
execute("/mop targetclear")
mop.actions.stop_movement("local")
if slot == initiator_slot then
    mop.log("Opposite Rows finished successfully on all visible characters.")
end
